title: Project Kickoff Call
goal_zh: 你是硬體窗口，和客戶確認專案目標與時程，並承諾會後提供時程與風險清單。

lines.en: Thanks for joining the kickoff call. Let's start with the project goal and the timeline.
lines.zh: 謝謝你參加開案會議。我們先從專案目標和時程開始。

lines.en: Sure. Our goal is to deliver a 24-port 10G managed switch, and we plan to start the engineering sample build in eight weeks.
lines.zh: 好的。我們的目標是交付一台24埠10G的網管型交換器，預計八週後開始工程樣品試產。

lines.en: Eight weeks is a bit tight for us. Can you pull it in by two weeks?
lines.zh: 八週對我們有點趕。你們可以提前兩週嗎？

lines.en: I understand your concern. We need to confirm the component lead times first, and I will give you a clear answer by Friday.
lines.zh: 我了解你的顧慮。我們需要先確認零件交期，我會在週五前給你明確答覆。

lines.en: Who will be the main contact for hardware issues?
lines.zh: 硬體問題的主要窗口是誰？

lines.en: I will be your single point of contact, and my manager will join the weekly meeting.
lines.zh: 我會擔任你們的單一窗口，我的主管會參加每週會議。

lines.en: Great. Please send us the project schedule and the risk list after the call.
lines.zh: 太好了。會後請寄給我們專案時程和風險清單。

lines.en: No problem. I will send the draft schedule and the risk list by the end of the day tomorrow.
lines.zh: 沒問題。我會在明天下班前寄出時程草稿和風險清單。

phrases.en: Let me confirm that I understand correctly.
phrases.zh: 讓我確認我的理解是否正確。

phrases.en: That is a bit tight for us.
I will get back to you by Friday.

phrases.zh: 你可以說明一下這項需求嗎？

phrases.en: I will follow up by email.

title: Discussing the Specification
goal_zh: 客戶提出埠數、電源與溫度需求，你要確認、說明可行性與影響，並承諾回覆時間。

lines.en: We need 24 ports of 10G SFP plus and four 100G uplink ports.
lines.zh: 我們需要24個10G SFP+埠，以及四個100G上行埠。

lines.en: Understood. For the uplinks, do you prefer QSFP28 ports?
lines.zh: 了解。上行埠的部分，你們偏好QSFP28埠嗎？

lines.en: Yes, QSFP28. Also, we want redundant power supplies and hot-swappable fans.
lines.zh: 對，QSFP28。我們也要備援電源供應器和可熱插拔的風扇。

lines.en: That is feasible. With redundant power supplies, the maximum power consumption will be around 300 watts.
lines.zh: 那是可行的。有備援電源的話，最大功耗大約在300瓦左右。

lines.en: What is the operating temperature range?
lines.zh: 工作溫度範圍是多少？

lines.en: The standard range is zero to forty degrees Celsius. If you need an extended range, we must change some components.
lines.zh: 標準範圍是攝氏0到40度。如果你們需要更寬的範圍，我們必須更換一些零件。

lines.en: We need it to work up to fifty-five degrees. Can you support that?
lines.zh: 我們需要它能在最高55度下運作。你們能支援嗎？

lines.en: Let me check with the thermal team, and I will send you a feasibility report next week.
lines.zh: 我跟散熱團隊確認一下，下週寄給你可行性報告。

phrases.en: Is that a hard requirement or a nice-to-have?
phrases.zh: 那是硬性需求，還是有更好？

phrases.en: That is feasible, but it will impact the cost.
phrases.zh: 那是可行的，但會影響成本。

phrases.en: Let me check with the team.
Could you share the detailed specification?
phrases.zh: 你可以提供詳細規格嗎？

phrases.en: We can support that with some design changes.
phrases.zh: 我們可以透過一些設計變更來支援。

stage: 價格與交期 Price & Lead Time
title: Quotation and Lead Time
goal_zh: 客戶詢問報價、折扣與交期，你要說明價格依據，提出條件，並說明需要和公司內部確認。

lines.en: Before we place the order, we need your quotation for one thousand units.
lines.zh: 下單前，我們需要你們一千台的報價。

lines.en: Sure. The unit price is based on the current BOM cost, and it includes one year of warranty.
lines.zh: 好的。單價是依據目前的BOM成本計算，並且包含一年保固。

lines.en: The price is higher than we expected. Is there room for a discount?
lines.zh: 價格比我們預期的高。還有折扣空間嗎？

lines.en: If you can commit to five thousand units a year, we may be able to offer a better price.
lines.zh: 如果你們能承諾一年五千台，我們也許能提供更好的價格。

lines.en: What about the lead time after we place a purchase order?
lines.zh: 下採購單之後的交期是多久？

lines.en: The standard lead time is twelve weeks, because the switch chip has a long lead time.
lines.zh: 標準交期是十二週，因為交換器晶片的交期很長。

lines.en: Can you ship the first batch earlier, say in eight weeks?
lines.zh: 你們可以提早出第一批貨嗎，比如八週內？

lines.en: We can try to expedite part of the order, but I need to confirm with our supply chain team first.
lines.zh: 我們可以試著加速部分訂單，但我需要先和供應鏈團隊確認。

phrases.en: That is outside my authority. I will check with my manager.
phrases.zh: 這超出我的權限，我會和主管確認。

phrases.en: We can offer a volume discount.
phrases.zh: 我們可以提供量大折扣。

phrases.en: The lead time depends on component availability.
phrases.zh: 交期取決於零件的供貨狀況。
你可以提供你們的預測量嗎？

phrases.en: We need to confirm the minimum order quantity.
phrases.zh: 我們需要確認最小訂購量。
